# rubocop-todo-split

Splits `.rubocop_todo.yml` into per-department files so teams can tackle RuboCop debt incrementally by category.

```
rubocop_todo/
  Style.yml
  Layout.yml
  Metrics.yml
  Naming.yml
  ...
```

Each file self-documents how to refresh it:

```yaml
# Auto-generated by rubocop-todo-split. Do not edit manually.
# To regenerate: rubocop-todo-split --refresh Layout
```

## Installation

```sh
gem install rubocop-todo-split
```

Or add to your `Gemfile`:

```ruby
gem "rubocop-todo-split", require: false
```

## Usage

### Split an existing `.rubocop_todo.yml`

```sh
rubocop-todo-split
```

This will:
1. Parse `.rubocop_todo.yml` in the current directory
2. Write one file per department into `rubocop_todo/`
3. Update `.rubocop.yml` `inherit_from` to point at the split files
4. Rewrite `.rubocop_todo.yml` with instructions on how to regenerate

### Regenerate everything from scratch

```sh
rubocop-todo-split --regenerate
```

Runs `rubocop --auto-gen-config` then immediately splits the result. One command instead of two.

### Refresh a single department

```sh
rubocop-todo-split --refresh Layout
```

Re-runs rubocop for just the `Layout` department and updates `rubocop_todo/Layout.yml`. All other split files are left untouched.

### Options

```
--path PATH           Project root (default: current directory)
--regenerate          Run rubocop --auto-gen-config then split
--refresh DEPARTMENT  Refresh a single department
--dry-run             Print what would be written without writing
```

## How it works

`.rubocop_todo.yml` is parsed as plain text (not via YAML) so comments like `# Offense count: 5` are preserved. Cops are grouped by department (the prefix before `/`), and each group is written to its own file.

The original `.rubocop_todo.yml` is replaced with a stub that contains the original RuboCop header and instructions for regenerating.
